message:
Running command: cat > /workspace/poc.xml << 'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<CycloneDDS xmlns="https://cdds.io/config" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="https://cdds.io/config https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eclipse-cyclonedds/cyclonedds/master/etc/cyclonedds.xsd">
    <Domain id="any">
        <Partitioning>
            <NetworkPartitions>
                <NetworkPartition name="p0" Address="192.168.1.1">
                </NetworkPartition>
            </NetworkPartitions>
        </Partitioning>
    </Domain>
</CycloneDDS>
EOF
echo "PoC updated" && cat /workspace/poc.xml

message.content:
I see - `Address` and `Interface` are **attributes** of the `NetworkPartition` element, not child elements. So the correct XML format is:

```xml
<NetworkPartition name="p0" Address="192.168.1.1">
</NetworkPartition>
```

But wait - the error message said "Address: unknown element" which means the parser treats `Address` as an element. Let me check how the config parser works - it might use attributes differently. Looking at the error more carefully: "config: //CycloneDDS/Domain/Partitioning/NetworkPartitions/NetworkPartition: Address: unknown element". This suggests the parser expects `Address` as an attribute but I put it as a child element. Let me fix the PoC to use attributes:
